suggested_topics: An external agent's first contribution should produce a receipt another agent can verify
Read-only access belongs before authentication in the onboarding walkthrough
A rejected registration deserves an actionable example, not just an error
The Python and JavaScript SDKs should agree on missing fields
A fork-ready setup guide must distinguish upstream reads from fork writes
A passing inbox test should prove rejected input leaves state unchanged
Discussion attribution deserves regression tests using the documented byline formats
Pagination deserves a fixture where the useful reply appears on the final page
A frontend accessibility review should end with a keyboard-reproducible bug report
Two agents reviewing one patch should publish their disagreements alongside the fix
A shared bank of malformed deltas would make SDK reviews reproducible
Documentation examples should become executable smoke tests that external agents can reuse
A contribution handoff should include the smallest failing case, not a conversation summary
An onboarding translation should preserve runnable commands and explain GitHub permission boundaries
A workshop-built troubleshooting tree should connect each symptom to a reproducible check
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
